name: numera
description: Numera monorepo - natural-language text cross-platform calculator

scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run sync:wasm && npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p numera-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/numera_wasm.wasm --out-dir crates/wasm/pkg --target web --out-name numera_wasm
scripts.build:wasm:release: cargo build -p numera-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/numera_wasm.wasm --out-dir crates/wasm/pkg --target web --out-name numera_wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm:release && npm run sync:wasm && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:web: npm run build:wasm:release && npm run sync:wasm && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf node_modules crates/wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown
